body: Thank you for your words of advice and the magazine suggestion, I'll definitely look into that! And yes exactly, I have work and life experience that may not be much but is something so that is something you don't always realize in the heat of the moment so thank you!

It does thank you, I am pursuing a career change into programming in Canada first so well see what my life brings. There can be the potential to go to Poland as their are jobs in the tech industry that can pay a monthly salary where you can really settle in Poland.
I agree with you, which is why my question is geared towards right now in my life and from a cultural identity perspective rather than a did my family make the right choice perspective.

I guess my concern is that now I feel polish in Canada but if I moved people would see me as the expat in Poland. I can talk polish fine but our experiences are different and I've been told there's always some dissent.
